en: Black‑and‑white divided postcard. The upper image shows the facade of a multi‑story urban building with the sign 'Central‑Schlachthof' and a ground‑floor restaurant; various German inscriptions are visible on signs and windows. The lower image depicts a large interior dining hall with long tables laid with white tablecloths and flowers, and on the back wall hang two flags with swastikas flanking a central portrait. In the middle of the card is the caption 'Meißen a. d. Elbe.'
